title: Ending a Memory Care Residency: Notice of Termination and the Fee End Date
content:
A Memory Care Residency Agreement residency ends by a notice of termination, by death or by a discharge, and the monthly rate runs through a fee end date fixed by the way it ends.

## Clause

1. **Signing a notice.** A notice of termination must be signed by a representative whose authority on the resident's customer record is financial power of attorney, durable power of attorney or guardian. The same authority is required to withdraw a notice. A signed notice is recorded with its notice date and the intended vacate date, and the residency is then in notice given status; a notice withdrawn before the intended vacate date returns the residency to active status.
2. **Fee end date.** The monthly rate runs through the fee end date, which is:
   - after a notice of termination, the later of the vacate date and the notice date plus 30 calendar days;
   - on death, the later of the vacate date and the date of death plus 7 calendar days;
   - after a discharge, the vacate date.
   The vacate date is the date the suite is surrendered; where the residency ends without notice it is the date the belongings were removed.
3. **Days already billed.** Days after the fee end date that were already billed are returned as move-out proration credits.

## Fee end date by ending

| How the residency ends | Compared dates | Fee end date |
|---|---|---|
| Notice of termination | Vacate date; notice date plus 30 days | The later of the two |
| Death | Vacate date; date of death plus 7 days | The later of the two |
| Discharge | Vacate date | The vacate date |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

| Ending | Facts | Fee end date |
|---|---|---|
| Notice | Notice signed 10 May; suite surrendered 31 May. Notice date plus 30 days is 9 June. | 9 June |
| Notice | Notice signed 10 May; suite surrendered 20 June. | 20 June |
| Death | Date of death 3 August; belongings removed 6 August. Date of death plus 7 days is 10 August. | 10 August |
| Death | Date of death 3 August; belongings removed 14 August. | 14 August |
| Discharge | Belongings removed 5 October. | 5 October |

In the first case, June was billed in advance in full; the days 10 to 30 June, 21 days, fall after the fee end date and are returned as a move-out proration credit.

## Basis Q&A

**Does an adult child without a recorded power of attorney or guardianship sign the notice?** No. Only a representative recorded with financial power of attorney, durable power of attorney or guardian authority signs a notice or its withdrawal.
